<section class="paper-section" id="opd">
  <div class="section-heading compact">
    <p class="eyebrow">2 篇论文</p>
    <h2>OPD</h2>

  <div class="paper-grid">
<article class="paper-card" id="self-distilled-rlvr">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.04</span>
    <span>OPD</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Self-Distilled RLVR</h3>
  <p>该论文提出 Self-Distilled RLVR，将 on-policy distillation 与 RLVR 结合，由更大的教师模型为每条采样轨迹提供细粒度密集信号。该方法缓解了标准 RLVR 信号稀疏的问题。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.03128" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>
  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="learning-beyond-teacher-generalized-on-policy-distillation-with-reward-extrapolation">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.02</span>
    <span>OPD</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Learning beyond Teacher: Generalized On-Policy Distillation with Reward Extrapolation</h3>
  <p>该论文证明 on-policy distillation 是 dense KL-constrained RL 的一个特例，并提出带灵活参考模型和奖励缩放因子的 G-OPD。其 reward extrapolation 版本 ExOPD 相比标准 OPD 更强，并能在融合 RL 训练的领域专家时让学生模型超越教师边界。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">

  </div>
</article>
  </div>
</section>
<section class="paper-section" id="reward-modeling">
  <div class="section-heading compact">
    <p class="eyebrow">3 篇论文</p>
    <h2>奖励建模</h2>

  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.03</span>
    <span>奖励建模</span>
  </div>
  <h3>MemReward: Graph-Based Experience Memory for LLM Reward Prediction with Limited Labels</h3>
  <p>该论文提出 MemReward，一个基于图经验记忆的奖励预测框架，在有限标签下让 3B 和 1.5B 模型分别达到 Oracle 表现的 97.3% 和 96.6%。它还在域外任务上超过 Oracle。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">

  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="scaling-reward-modeling-without-human-supervision">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.03</span>
    <span>奖励建模</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Scaling Reward Modeling without Human Supervision</h3>
  <p>该论文研究无需人工标注的无监督奖励模型扩展，通过学习网页语料文档前缀与后缀之间的偏好来训练奖励模型。实验显示该方法在不同模型骨干上稳定提升 RewardBench，并改进 best-of-N 选择和策略优化。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.02225" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>
  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="reward-modeling-from-natural-language-human-feedback">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.01</span>
    <span>奖励建模</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Reward Modeling from Natural Language Human Feedback</h3>
  <p>该论文将偏好数据上的 RLVR 用于训练生成式奖励模型，指出二分类任务会让 GRM 倾向于猜对结果而非给出可靠批判。论文提出方法缓解这一问题。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.07349" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>
  </div>
</article>
  </div>
</section>

  <div class="paper-meta">

    <span>视频生成强化学习</span>
  </div>
  <h3>KVPO: ODE-Native GRPO for Autoregressive Video Alignment via KV Semantic Exploration</h3>
  <p>KVPO 使用 ODE-native online GRPO 框架，将流式自回归视频生成器与人类偏好对齐。它用历史 KV 缓存的因果语义路由替代噪声探索，并基于 Trajectory Velocity Energy 优化速度场代理策略。</p>

    <span>推理强化学习</span>
  </div>
  <h3>All Roads Lead to Rome: Incentivizing Divergent Thinking in Vision-Language Models</h3>
  <p>该论文提出 MUPO，一种强化学习方法，通过激励多解之间的发散思考来缓解 GRPO 训练 VLM 时的多样性坍塌。它让模型形成更深且更广的推理模式。</p>

<article class="paper-card" id="the-art-of-efficient-reasoning-data-reward-and-optimization">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.03</span>
    <span>推理强化学习</span>
  </div>
  <h3>The Art of Efficient Reasoning: Data, Reward, and Optimization</h3>
  <p>该论文研究 LLM 的高效推理，通过 RL 激励短而准确的推理轨迹。论文总结了训练阶段、奖励设计和优化策略，并在 0.6B 到 30B 模型上分析泛化规律。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.20945" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>

  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="fipo-eliciting-deep-reasoning-with-future-kl-influenced-policy-optimization">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.03</span>
    <span>推理强化学习</span>
  </div>
  <h3>FIPO: Eliciting Deep Reasoning with Future-KL Influenced Policy Optimization</h3>
  <p>该论文提出 FIPO，一种强化学习算法，用于解决 LLM 推理瓶颈中的粗粒度信用分配问题。它针对 GRPO 式训练中结果奖励无法区分关键逻辑转折与普通 token 的问题进行改进。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.19835" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>
  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="agentic-proposing-enhancing-large-language-model-reasoning-via-compositional-skill-synthesis">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.02</span>
    <span>推理强化学习</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Agentic Proposing: Enhancing Large Language Model Reasoning via Compositional Skill Synthesis</h3>
  <p>该论文提出 Agentic Proposing，一个使用专门智能体和 Multi-Granularity Policy Optimization 动态选择、组合模块化推理技能的框架。该框架用于合成高精度训练轨迹，从而增强大语言模型推理能力。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03279" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>
  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="deepseek-r1-incentivizing-reasoning-capability-in-llms-via-reinforcement-learning">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2025.01</span>
    <span>推理强化学习</span>
  </div>
  <h3>DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning</h3>
  <p>该论文展示纯强化学习无需人工标注推理轨迹即可直接激发 LLM 的高级推理行为。所提出框架诱导自我反思、验证和自适应策略使用，并在数学、代码和 STEM 推理任务上取得强提升。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">

<section class="paper-section" id="agentic-rl">
  <div class="section-heading compact">
    <p class="eyebrow">5 篇论文</p>

  </div>
  <div class="paper-grid">
<article class="paper-card" id="spreadsheet-rl-advancing-large-language-model-agents-on-realistic-spreadsheet-tasks-via-reinforcement-learning">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.05</span>
    <span>智能体强化学习</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Spreadsheet-RL: Advancing Large Language Model Agents on Realistic Spreadsheet Tasks via Reinforcement Learning</h3>
  <p>Spreadsheet-RL 是一个用于在真实 Microsoft Excel 环境中训练专用表格智能体的强化学习微调框架，面向提示式智能体难以处理的复杂多步工作流。它结合自动化起止表格数据构建、多轮 Spreadsheet Gym 沙盒工具环境，以及 Domain-Spreadsheet 基准，以提升真实表格自动化能力。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.22642" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>

  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="search-r2-enhancing-search-integrated-reasoning-via-actor-refiner-collaboration">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.02</span>
    <span>智能体强化学习</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Search-R2: Enhancing Search-Integrated Reasoning via Actor-Refiner Collaboration</h3>
  <p>该论文提出 Actor-Refiner 协作机制，解决搜索增强推理 RL 中的多尺度信用分配问题。它缓解稀疏轨迹级奖励难以区分高质量推理与偶然猜对的问题，并减少冗余或误导性搜索行为。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2602.03647" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>
  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="arena-rl-training-llms-as-game-players-with-vision-language-action-models">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2026.01</span>
    <span>智能体强化学习</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Arena-RL: Training LLMs as Game Players with Vision-Language Action Models</h3>
  <p>该论文提出 Arena-RL，一个通过视觉语言动作模型训练 LLM 驱动智能体玩视觉游戏的强化学习框架，重点从交互式游戏反馈中改进策略。实验表明，基于游戏轨迹的奖励优化能显著提升策略决策与跨游戏泛化。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.06487" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>
  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="search-r1-training-llms-to-reason-and-leverage-search-engines-with-reinforcement-learning">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2025.03</span>
    <span>智能体强化学习</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning</h3>
  <p>该论文提出 Search-R1，一个让 LLM 在逐步推理中通过 RL 学会自主生成搜索查询并使用实时检索的框架。它提升了模型获取外部知识和最新信息的能力。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
<a class="resource-link" href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.09516" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/arxiv.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />论文</a>
<a class="resource-link" href="https://github.com/PeterGriffinJin/Search-R1" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><img src="../../assets/icons/github.svg" alt="" aria-hidden="true" />代码</a>
  </div>
</article>
<article class="paper-card" id="search-o1-agentic-search-enhanced-large-reasoning-models">
  <div class="paper-meta">
    <span>2025.01</span>
    <span>智能体强化学习</span>
  </div>
  <h3>Search-o1: Agentic Search-Enhanced Large Reasoning Models</h3>
  <p>该论文提出 Search-o1，一个用智能体式检索增强生成机制和 Reason-in-Documents 模块增强大推理模型的框架。它通过精炼检索文档来缓解长程推理中的知识不足。</p>

  <h3>SRPO: Self-Referential Policy Optimization for Vision-Language-Action Models</h3>
  <p>该论文提出 SRPO，一个用于视觉语言动作模型的强化学习框架，用模型自身成功轨迹中的进展式奖励替代稀疏二元奖励。它利用潜在世界模型表征稳健衡量行为进展，并以更少 RL 步数在 LIBERO 上取得最优操作成功率。</p>
  <div class="paper-links">
